title: SA-Bench: Evaluating Semantic Alignment in LLM-Based Paper Reproduction
abstract: arXiv:2608.24252v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents can generate paper reproduction code, yet often produce scientifically unfaithful implementations. We define this failure mode as semantic drift, where generated code silently diverges from the paper's specifications. We introduce SemanticAlign-Bench(SA-Bench), a diagnostic benchmark covering 30 papers from ICLR, ICML and NeurIPS 2025. For each paper, we decompose its specifications into atomic and verifiable implementation claims, which we call Semantic Alignment Units (SAUs) and evaluate repositories along four diagnostic dimensions spanning numerical, methodological, protocol and ordering drift. In total, we construct 1,491 SAUs across five ML domains and evaluate 12 generator configurations (4 models $\times$ 3 scaffolds). Even the strongest configuration (Claude+PaperCoder) achieves a mean SAU score of only 0.301 out of 1.0, with an overall mean of 0.221 across 360 evaluations. translated_title: SA-Bench：评估基于LLM的论文复现中的语义对齐
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24252v1 公告类型：新 摘要：LLM智能体可以生成论文复现代码，但常常产生科学上不忠实的实现。我们将这种失败模式定义为语义漂移，即生成的代码在不知不觉中偏离了论文的规范。我们引入了SemanticAlign-Bench（SA-Bench），一个诊断基准，涵盖来自ICLR、ICML和NeurIPS 2025的30篇论文。对于每篇论文，我们将其规范分解为原子且可验证的实现声明，称为语义对齐单元（SAUs），并沿四个诊断维度评估代码仓库，涵盖数值、方法论、协议和排序漂移。总共，我们在五个机器学习领域构建了1,491个SAUs，并评估了12种生成器配置（4个模型×3个脚手架）。即使最强的配置（Claude+PaperCoder）平均SAU分数仅为0.301（满分1.0），在360次评估中总体平均值为0.221。一个失败分类法揭示了智能体尝试但未能正确对齐的问题。
tldr: 本文提出了SA-Bench基准，通过语义对齐单元系统评估LLM在论文复现中的语义漂移，发现最强配置的语义对齐分数也仅为0.301，揭示了生成代码与论文规范之间的显著偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SA-Bench, a benchmark that systematically evaluates semantic drift in LLM-based paper reproduction via semantic alignment units, revealing that even the strongest configuration achieves only 0.301 alignment score, highlighting significant deviations between generated code and paper specifications.
